observation: Frame 35 render shows pipes but no visible liquid jet/spray, splashes, or puddle; scene appears washed-out/overexposed.
expected_behavior: A continuous fan-shaped liquid jet (approx 45° downward) hitting the floor with splashes/droplets and a growing puddle by frame 35.
actual_behavior: No visible liquid surface or droplets; only pipe geometry is readable and lighting is heavily clipped, making water (if present) invisible.
recommended_fix: Set liquid domain to be render-visible (domain.hide_render=False) or render the generated liquid mesh object; reduce light energies by ~4-8x or lower scene exposure; ensure liquid mesh baking/output is enabled (Domain > Liquid > Mesh).
analysis_notes: Render shows no liquid and is washed out; script explicitly hides domain from render and uses high-intensity lights. VDB cache exists, suggesting bake ran, but if mesh isn't rendered (or domain hidden) liquid will not appear.
